cells.name: schedule
cells.lb: for SATs of GYRO RLG SIGMA 40 as per IHQ MoD (N) / DSR approved schedule. Following observed:-

cells.value: Check the correctness of wiring to and from interfaced units.
Check fan of Processor electronic unit working correctly.
Check Degaussing function on display (not for LCD displays).
Check access of main and sub-menu functions.
Check for available pulse length (short/Medium/Long) in various range scales.
Check modes of stabilisation (Sea / Ground) and presentation Modes (TM / RM / etc) by joystick / track ball and access to cursor Read out data.
Check position of cursor on display and its control.
Minimum safe CPA and TCPA alarms check.
Check display of parallel index line.
Check Target tracking by ARPA function.
Check interfaces with Log, Gyro, ECDIS, GPS, AIS and CMS (If fitted).
Check selection of range scales from minimum to maximum (available range scales as per TD to be indicated to trial agency by Presenting Authority).
Check interface for track table output with Trigun / CMS / CTD (as applicable).
Check generation of pre-sync pulse and interfacing the same to Interference Suppression Unit.
Check for facility for naming of contacts.

tables_1.title: Designed/specific values to be achieved for the following tests may be mentioned (values depending on antenna height, sea state and types/size of targets etc as given in user manual/TD/IMO Regulations to be indicated to trial Agency by Presenting Authority prior to commencement of trials):-

cells.value: Radar should be capable of displaying two point targets on the same bearing, separated by 40m in range, as two distinct objects (*)
Radar should be capable of displaying two point targets at the same range, separated by 2.5 degree in bearing, as two distinct objects(*)
Range and Bearing Accuracy(*) (IMO Resolution MSC.192(79))

cells.lb: Range - within 30m or 1% of range scale in use, whichever is greater(*) Bearing - within 1 degree(*)
To be recorded as per ship fit.

fields.Note: The extant IMO regulations on Radar / ARPA may be used for reference. For example, IMO Resolutions MSC.192 (79) for Radar, IMO Resolution A. 823(19) for ARPA etc.
